assignments.essential_function: Prepare a cited meeting brief with account history, open commitments and discovery questions.

review: Full source builds a sourced pre-call brief from meeting details, account/opportunity records, prior transcripts, emails and chat, then proposes an objective, discovery questions and likely objections. Explicitly read-only and names missing coverage. Its Gong/Google Drive guidance is specific to the native connector environment; file/notes fallback is built in. It neither schedules nor records the call.
native_prerequisites: Upcoming meeting/account details and whatever relevant CRM records, notes or transcripts exist
Optional calendar, CRM, Gong/transcripts, email, docs and chat; uploads and pasted notes are natively supported
No connector actions needed for the file-based preparation workflow
